newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira sees good 97 prospects, some doubts.
newsitem.headline: Kemira sees good 97 prospects, some doubts.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy said on Monday it expected business prospects to remain good this year despite some uncertainties.

"The prospects for the Kemira group in 1997 continue to be good in most respects although there are some uncertainties related to the development of economic growth, the length of the downcycle in the pulp and paper industry and the weather," Kemira said in a statement with its 1996 results.
The profitability of the Chemicals business group was expected to remain at a good level, Kemira said.

"In the short-term, the pulp and paper industry shutdowns and production curtailments will continue to depress the sales volumes of pulp and paper chemicals and prices for hydrogen peroxide continue to be depressed," it said.
Later this year, demand for chemicals was expected to improve, it added.
The profitability of Kemira Agro -- the group's fertilisers unit -- was expected to remain at a good level, Kemira said.

Referring to its troubled Pigments division, Kemira said the price increases announced in December would improve the situation "but will not alone be enough to bring profitability to a satisfactory level."
Measures to keep costs in check and improve efficiency would continue. Demand for titanium oxide was expected to rise provided that economic growth continued, Kemira said.
At Tikkurila, Kemira's paints unit, profitability was expected to remain at a good level, it said.
